newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes lower.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed lower on Monday due to a lack of demand for liquidity in the market, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.524 percent against Thursday's pre-holiday close of 4.653, with 30-day commercial paper staying unchanged at 4.75-5.80. Dealers expected the rates to remain steady in the near term.
The bond market did not see transaction in the afternoon. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield ended morning trade at 5.6800.
The markets were closed on Friday and Saturday due to national holidays. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
